en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, raising it, said, 
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘The intellect is a covering veil, and the merit is an apparent beauty,

therefore veil the beauty of your mannerisms by your merit, and fight against your personal desires by your intellect, (and) the cordiality would be submissive to you and the love would manifest for you’.
